card.name: Comma after Serious in respiratory warning
card.fires_on: The comma right after the word Serious in the opioid heading-and-sentence 'Life-Threatening Respiratory Depression Serious, life-threatening, or fatal respiratory depression'. A weaker case is the first piece of a rare proper name such as a ship name.

modes.label: Comma after Serious
modes.description: The comma following 'Serious' at the start of the respiratory depression warning sentence, right after the heading.
modes.example: Life-Threatening Respiratory Depression Serious<<,>> life-threatening, or fatal respiratory depression may

modes.label: Start of a rare name
modes.description: The first letter piece of an unusual proper name in general web text.
